engine: actual Linux Tauri/WebKit and GTK, private authenticated Xvfb
findings: Exact native server identity stays visible during private entry; long configuration scrolls separately.
Private values are entered in GTK, outside WebKit; saving and connection consent are separate.
Literal metadata and exact generation strings remain inspectable.
Authentication saved/revoked states are visible at wide/narrow sizes.
Explicit local host-account execution disclosure is retained.
limits: Synthetic DOM/XTest input, not physical-input acceptance
OAuth and full trust/discovery/input/media acceptance are not covered
